claim_en: THE GIFT IS A FORMAL SEPARATION, MADE BEFORE — NOT TO. ve-yikchu li terumah ('let them take Me an offering') rendered ve-yafreshun KODAMAI afrashuta ('let them SET APART BEFORE ME a SEPARATION'): the donation defined by the separation-verb (the priestly-dues vocabulary), directed to the audience-preposition 'before Me,' with the willing heart (de-yitre'ei libbei) the sole trigger.

THE INDWELLING IS ROUTED THROUGH THE PRESENCE, AND IT LANDS IN THE PEOPLE. ve-shakhanti be-tokham ('and I will dwell among them') rendered ve-ashrei SHEKHINTI beinehon ('and I will make MY PRESENCE dwell AMONG THEM') — the Presence-layer inserted (the same double-buffering exo_24's vision records), and the among-THEM kept: the dwelling lands in the people, not in the building just commissioned, which is made kodamai ('before Me').

source: Onkelos on Exod 25:9; the case shelf at Mishnah Shevuot 2:2 + Sanhedrin 1:5
claim_en: VE-KHEN TAASU ('and SO shall you make') AS THE CONSTITUTIONAL CLAUSE. The closing words of the pattern-command are read by the case shelf as the standing rule for ALL later sanctuary work: extensions of the city and the courts follow the shown pattern under full authority — king, prophet, and the seventy-one (Mishnah Shevuot 2:2; Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:5 — the 71-docket this corpus seats at EX18-14). The pattern itself: tavnit rendered DEMUT ('likeness'), shown (machaze) to Moses.

THE PARASHAH'S FIRST STANDING PROHIBITION: the ark's poles NEVER leave — lo yasuru mimennu rendered la ye'idun minnei ('they shall not be removed from it'): a permanent law inside the architecture, the one carry-duty clause of the chapter — the ark is forever ready to move.

THE MEETING IS THE WORD'S APPOINTMENT — THE ORACLE INTERFACE INSTALLED. ve-noadeti lekha sham ('and I will meet with you there') rendered ve-EZAMMEN MEMRI lakh tamman ('and I will APPOINT MY WORD for you there') — the Memra-layer at the meeting-point: from above the cover, between the two cherubim, comes 'ALL THAT I SHALL COMMAND you to the sons of Israel' — the fixed address of every future ruling.

source: Onkelos on Exod 25:30; case rows at Mishnah Menachot 11:4-11:7
claim_en: THE TABLE'S DUTY IS CONTINUOUS. lechem panim rendered lechem APPAYA kodamai TEDIRA ('the bread of the FACE before Me CONTINUALLY') — the tadir-token makes the table a standing duty, not a furnishing; the dimensions and the exchange procedure are the case rows of Mishnah Menachot 11:4 + 11:5 + 11:7 (TESTING shelf, Step 9's docket).

source: Onkelos on Exod 25:31-36; the case row at Mishnah Menachot 3:7
claim_en: ONE DRAWN PIECE, SEVEN BRANCHES. mikshah ('hammered work') rendered NEGID ('DRAWN out' — beaten from one piece), closing at 25:36: kullah NEGIDA CHADA ('ALL of it ONE DRAWN PIECE of pure gold') — the one-piece constraint held in translation; six branches from its two sides (25:32) with the shaft the seventh — the count whose case row is Mishnah Menachot 3:7 (the seven branches invalidate one another).

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Terumah 3 (Reish Lakish) + Buber 2; Tanchuma Terumah 1
claim_en: THE FIVE-DISQUALIFIED TABLE DERIVED WORD BY WORD FROM THIS VERSE. Reish Lakish: five may not separate the offering, and every exclusion sits in our 25:2's own tokens — the deaf-mute from SPEAK-to-the-sons-of-Israel, the incompetent from whose-heart-makes-him-willing, the minor from every-MAN, the not-his-owner from from-each-man-TAKE (from your own), the gentile from the-sons-of-Israel. Mishnah Terumot 1:1's list, token-anchored here. Rider: the SURPLUS law (motar terumah becomes gold leaf for the Holy of Holies — the Shekalim 4:6 question opened by the Tanchuma's own yelamdenu).

THE PARASHAH'S TIMESTAMP AND ITS ATONEMENT-PURPOSE. There is NO EARLIER-AND-LATER in the Torah: this section was spoken to Moses on the DAY OF ATONEMENT itself — after the calf, though written before it — and the purpose follows: let the GOLD of the tabernacle atone for the gold of the calf; hence the name TABERNACLE OF TESTIMONY — testimony that the calf was forgiven. A recorded delta between narrative order and event order, with the ordering doctrine named.

A COUNTED CORRESPONDENCE AND A SPECIES DISPUTE ON THE MATERIALS LIST. R. Yehudah bar Simon: the offering-list's THIRTEEN items answer the THIRTEEN things done for Israel in Egypt (Ezekiel 16's garment list), thirteen to be repaid (Isaiah 4:5-6) — the count is the midrash's own, the ink enumeration checkable and grouping-dependent, carried dual-track. And the TACHASH: R. Yehudah — a real great pure beast, one horn, six colors; R. Nechemiah — a miracle-work, created for its hour and hidden (whence a thirty-cubit hide?) — the same open puzzle Onkelos carries as the name sasgona.

THE MISHNAH'S TWO TABLES ARE THIS VERSE TIMES TWO CONSTANTS. R. Yehudah's ten-by-five and R. Meir's twelve-by-six (Mishnah Menachot 11:5) are both our 25:23's own two-cubits-by-one under the recorded cubit constants (five vs six handbreadths) — a verse-times-constant computation, with the loaves' fold geometry, the wind-gap, and Abba Shaul's frankincense placement (al as ADJACENT, from Numbers 2:20) riding; and Ben Zoma derives the form-requirement from 25:30's own name — bread of the FACE, so it must have faces (Mishnah Menachot 11:4, with the dimension table and R. Yehudah's letter-numeral mnemonic).

WHAT 'CONTINUALLY' REQUIRES IS A RECORDED DISPUTE. The exchange procedure quotes our 25:30 as its proof — withdrawing and placing hands a handbreadth apart, the table never bare (Mishnah Menachot 11:7); R. Yose: even placed later the same day, that too is CONTINUALLY — no vacant night. Riding: the ascent principle (marble table for the incoming bread, gold for the outgoing — we ascend in holiness and do not descend) and the rod-work's Sabbath deference (Mishnah Menachot 11:6).

THE ARK FILE'S DERIVATION LAYER. The funding dispute (take-yourself from your own, R. Yoshiyah, against R. Yonatan's all-public with lekha as endearment — and the installation's take-lekha proven from-your-own by the goat/calf redundancy); the making-verbs harmonized by Abba Chanan's WILL-INDEXED dispatch (the public makes when Israel does the Presence's will), with the scholar's-townspeople dispatch beside it; the crown's consonants — written STRANGER, read CROWN: merited his crown, not merited estranged (with the three crowns: the ark's still lying for whoever will take it); the two standing prohibitions (detaching the breastplate, removing the staves — lashes both, the design-spec probe answered by the bare negative, the staves resolved as a mechanical spec: they loosen but do not slip out); and the manna jar located WITH the ark by three verbal-analogy chains (there-there, generations-generations, keeping-keeping). Filed F-098, auto-seated (round 26, the sanctuary block).

THE CANDELABRUM'S METHOD FORK AND THE TABLE'S RIDERS. The menorah verse run through BOTH rival inference engines — Rebbi's general-detail-general yielding of-metal (all metals valid) against R. Yosei b. R. Yehuda's amplify-limit-amplify excluding only earthenware: two valid-materials tables from one verse, middah governance measured on the unit's own ink. Beside it: promote-in-sanctity-never-demote on the shewbread's silver-to-gold path (with the exception's recorded physics — marble because metal scalds), and the treasury split at the sanctuary verse — craftsmen paid from maintenance consecrations, not altar consecrations ('they shall make ME' read from-what-is-MINE, R. Abahu). Filed F-099, auto-seated (round 26, the sanctuary block).

source: Onkelos Exod 25:2, 25:8, 25:15, 25:22, 25:30; Midrash Tanchuma, Terumah 1, 3, 5, 8; Berakhot 55a:11-12; Menachot 28b:17, 29a:1-2, 96a:6, 97a:5; Yoma 3b:3, 72a:9-10, 72b:7; Bava Batra 99a:7; Sukkah 50b:6-7; Mishnah Terumot 1:1; Shekalim 4:4, 4:6, 6:1, 6:4; Yoma 5:1-2; Kelim 17:9-10; Menachot 3:7, 11:4-7; Tamid 3:9; Shevuot 2:2; Sanhedrin 1:5
claim_en: THE SPEC GRADED AGAINST ITS OWN CONSTRUCTION RUN — THE ORDER RESTORED, THE USE-CLAUSES DROPPED, THE ARK'S ONE NAMED MAKER. Exod 25-27 in cold_run_sanctuary_build.py (257 of 257 first run) graded as a scene against 35:30-38:31: the run builds the house before the ark against the ark-first command (Berakhot 55a's fork, the spine's roles reversed); twenty-four use-clauses and pattern-clauses dropped; 'they shall make' at two seats; one named maker among thirty-seven; the crown's consonants; the staves' hapax; the meeting's hapax; the five tokens of 25:2; the table under two cubits reproducing Menachot 11:5; the lampstand's counts. Nine effects.
